name: Runway
tagline: Generative video and creative AI tools for images, video, and editing

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Standard plan listed at $15/month monthly and $12/month annually in public pricing references.

verdictSummary: A UI around video models is buildable; the video-generation model quality, compute, safety, editing stack, and continuous research are not a solo afternoon project.
coreLoopDIY: Wrap open-source/video APIs to generate or edit clips, manage credits, and export assets.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because generative video quality and inference infrastructure are the product.

priorArt.name: diffusers
priorArt.desc: Open-source library for diffusion models; useful for experimentation, not a Runway replace

notes: Important no for the frontier-model category.
